source_status: Observer R2 qualification active; no result assumed
confirmed_source_gaps: ChangeTargetEffect requires exactly one current target and lets the player choose a new recipient; not a fixed-self single-slot operation.
ContestedRetargetLogic changes arbitrary slots and applies global duplicate exclusion; cannot supply Spellskite semantics unchanged.
Its static expandRequirements helper does not retain originally selected group counts for optional or variable groups.

TargetsComponent.targetEntryStamps is keyed by physical entity id. Capturing the whole component would refresh unchanged targets; per-slot old/new visits of the same id cannot be represented distinctly by that map.
Damage distribution is keyed by entity id; modeTargetsOrdered and splicedTargetsOrdered are additional target views requiring consistency.
New-target trigger/ward emission and source-type legality must be reviewed explicitly rather than assumed from target list mutation.

planned_acceptance_cases.required_behavior: Redirect one legal creature target to the same battlefield visit of Spellskite; resolve damage on it.
Redirect a legal activated-ability target, checking the original ability controller and source characteristics.
Redirect a legal triggered-ability target with its captured source/controller; no spell-only restriction leakage.
Ability may target a stack object with zero targets; resolving it changes nothing.
Ability may target a spell whose target cannot legally become Spellskite; leave every target unchanged.
Spellskite leaves before resolution; no target changes.
Spellskite leaves and returns with the same physical entity id; the old ability must not retarget to the new visit.
Two legal slots from separate target requirements: controller chooses exactly one slot; other slot and count are unchanged.
One requirement selecting two targets: replace only one; forbid a duplicate Spellskite within that same target instance.
Distinct target instances may both name Spellskite when each is legal; do not apply a blanket global duplicate prohibition.
Replacing either slot cannot violate a later another-target restriction or otherwise make an unchanged target newly illegal.
Preserve same-controller/different-controller and other whole-group restrictions.
Use original stack object controller and source qualities for targeting restrictions; not the redirecting ability controller.
Keep the originally chosen target count, with correct requirement/slot mapping after optional or variable target counts.
An unchanged target already illegal before retargeting remains unchanged; do not silently refresh its captured object identity.
When one slot is retargeted to a new visit of an entity another slot targeted earlier, retain separate per-slot identities.
Move the chosen slot and its fixed original damage allocation together; retain all other shares and totals.
Preserve chosen modes, mode-local and splice-local target views; exactly the selected slot changes in every relevant view.
Actual Spellskite activation pays either one blue mana or two life; no free or double payment.
Round-trip state at a multi-slot choice; reject stale/illegal slot answers and reproduce accepted state/events exactly.
Emit the newly targeted occurrence required for targeting/ward triggers without retriggering unchanged targets.
No legal replacement leaves the stack object byte-identical, including target stamps and allocations.

negative_control_policy: No nonexistent-primitive compile failure can qualify as behavioral negative evidence. Freeze actual executable tests, source identity and valid controls before running a new primitive qualification.
required_followup: Implement a generic one-slot fixed-recipient retarget primitive with explicit target-instance and object-visit provenance.
Preserve existing target semantics and all82 legacy saved-state fixtures; optional fields must omit defaults where necessary.
Register Spellskite only after primitive qualification and fresh card metadata/printing checks; include CLB Printing row.
Run actual card snapshots for NPH and CLB, broad regressions, ordinary build and applicable Assay; classify any parser/fidelity gap honestly.
